headline: Bangladesh asks India to expedite Hasina's extradition
summary: The interim government has urged India to speed up the process of returning former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to Bangladesh.
details: Bangladesh has formally requested India to expedite the extradition of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, who is currently in India.
The request was discussed during a meeting between the Chief Adviser of the interim government and the Indian High Commissioner to Bangladesh.
Additionally, the interim government has urged India to return the killers of Hadi, a request made during the high-level diplomatic meeting.
Foreign Minister Ahmed Kaan says the government hopes India will cooperate in the extradition process to ensure justice and legal proceedings.
The move signals a push by the interim administration to hold the former leader accountable for her actions while in power.
caption:
Bangladesh is pushing India to bring back Sheikh Hasina. The interim government is now demanding her expedited extradition.

Bangladesh has formally requested India to expedite the extradition of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, who is currently in India.

The request was discussed during a meeting between the Chief Adviser of the interim government and the Indian High Commissioner to Bangladesh.

Additionally, the interim government has urged India to return the killers of Hadi, a request made during the high-level diplomatic meeting.

Foreign Minister Ahmed Kaan says the government hopes India will cooperate in the extradition process to ensure justice and legal proceedings.

The move signals a push by the interim administration to hold the former leader accountable for her actions while in power.

headline: 878 dead as measles outbreak kills five more in 24 hours
summary: The death toll from a measles outbreak in Bangladesh has reached 878, with five more children dying within a single day.
details: A measles outbreak has claimed the lives of 878 people, with five additional deaths reported in the last 24 hours.
The victims of the most recent deaths are reported to be children.
The outbreak is causing significant concern as the death toll continues to rise rapidly.
Health authorities are monitoring the situation as the number of casualties increases.
